scope: Cannabis/hemp scientific reference-image and evidence sources

references.sourceTitle: Cannabis Single-Element Nutrient Deficiency Supplement
references.diagnosticCeiling: High-confidence reference; image alone should still be checked against pH/EC/feed/history

references.imageType: RGB progression figures + tissue nutrient measurements
references.sourceTitle: Cannabis Nutrient Disorders — Deficiency and Toxicity Progression
references.diagnosticCeiling: Use symptom + nutrient context; some micronutrient visual signatures remain low-specificity

references.imageType: RGB stock/cutting/root/flower figures linked to RT-PCR/RT-qPCR
references.sourceTitle: HLVd RT-PCR/RT-qPCR Validated Cannabis Visual Reference Corpus
references.diagnosticCeiling: Visual output may say HLVd suspected only; molecular test required for confirmation

references.sourceTitle: Cannabis Female / Male / Hermaphrodite Floral Morphology Corpus
references.diagnosticCeiling: High-confidence morphology when reproductive structures are clearly visible

references.sourceTitle: Bugwood Cannabis-Host Licensed Pest/Disease Image Collection
references.diagnosticCeiling: Per-image evidence strength; retain photographer, image number, host, subject and license

references.sourceTitle: Cannabis Pythium / Globisporangium / Fusarium Root-Rot Pathogenicity Reference
references.diagnosticCeiling: Species-level photo diagnosis remains suspected without lab confirmation

references.sourceTitle: Industrial Hemp Greenhouse Water-Stress & Growth Image Dataset
references.diagnosticCeiling: High treatment confidence; regroup by plant/time sequence to prevent leakage

references.sourceTitle: USU Hemp Pests, Diseases & Abiotic Expert Reference Library
references.diagnosticCeiling: Use as evidence and image-comparison reference; not bulk training without item rights

references.sourceTitle: Cannabis Pathogens and Molds — Controlled Inoculation & Visual Reference
references.diagnosticCeiling: Organism-level confirmation follows source evidence; user-photo etiology should remain conservative

references.sourceTitle: Cannabis Greenhouse Pathogen Management — Multi-Stage Visual Reference
references.diagnosticCeiling: Useful for differential diagnosis; some etiologies still require lab confirmation

references.sourceTitle: Cannabis Molecular Diagnostics & Bioinformatics — HLVd Differential Reference
references.diagnosticCeiling: HLVd confirmation remains molecular, never visual-only

references.sourceTitle: HLVd Detection, Infectivity, Host Range and Transmission — RT-PCR Hemp Reference
references.diagnosticCeiling: Critical negative rule: absence of symptoms does not rule out HLVd

references.sourceTitle: Cannabis Fusarium Inflorescence Infection and Mycotoxin Reference
references.diagnosticCeiling: Etiologic confirmation follows culture/molecular evidence

references.sourceTitle: Cannabis Cystolith / Non-Glandular Trichome Microscopy Dataset
references.license: Article CC BY 4.0; repository data license unresolved
references.diagnosticCeiling: Do not redistribute/train publicly until data license is clarified

references.sourceTitle: Cannabis Glandular Trichome Development, Morphology and Maturation 2023
references.diagnosticCeiling: Amber/cloudy appearance is contextual, not a universal harvest-certainty label

references.imageType: Inflorescence RGB + culture plates + light/SEM microscopy
references.sourceTitle: High-THC Cannabis Total Yeast & Mold — Inflorescence Mold Reference
references.diagnosticCeiling: Photo can flag mold suspicion; species-level identification may require lab work

references.sourceTitle: Cannabis Full Life-Cycle Morphology and Mature Senescence Reference
references.diagnosticCeiling: Strong stage-aware healthy reference but only one cultivar

references.sourceTitle: Industrial Hemp Piercing-Sucking Pest Impact — Controlled Greenhouse Reference
references.diagnosticCeiling: Useful causal differential; not a large image-training corpus

references.imageType: Root colony + alate + sticky-card RGB figures
references.sourceTitle: Cannabis Rice Root Aphid - Root/Alate/Fungus-Gnat Differential Reference
references.diagnosticCeiling: General yellowing/decline alone is not diagnostic

references.sourceTitle: Cannabis Excess-Nutrient Salt Excretion and Pathogen-Lookalike Injury
references.diagnosticCeiling: White residue + necrosis must not automatically be called mildew/pathogen

references.sourceTitle: Hemp Fusarium Wilt and Seedling Damping-Off - Korea Pathogenicity Reference
references.diagnosticCeiling: Etiologic Fusarium label requires more than appearance alone

references.imageType: Symptom figures + molecular mono/dual/triple infection results
references.sourceTitle: Hemp Abnormal Growth - Mono, Dual and Triple Molecular Infections
references.diagnosticCeiling: Visual output must stay syndrome-level without molecular confirmation

references.sourceTitle: Hemp Beet Curly Top Disease - Molecular and Koch-Postulate Reference
references.license: Publisher copyright; no CC reuse located
references.diagnosticCeiling: No raw figure reuse without permission; visual diagnosis remains syndrome-level

references.sourceTitle: Purdue Industrial Hemp Beneficial Insects Visual Reference
references.diagnosticCeiling: Do not classify every arthropod on cannabis as a pest

references.imageType: Hemp field reference images + spatial-pattern text
references.sourceTitle: Cornell Hemp Abiotic-vs-Biotic and Mechanical Damage Reference
references.diagnosticCeiling: Use event/spatial context; image alone rarely proves the cause

references.sourceTitle: Cannabis Leaf Morphometrics & Developmental Identity Dataset
references.license: Article CC BY-NC; repository data terms verify
references.diagnosticCeiling: Unusual leaf shape alone must not be called disease/nutrient deficiency

references.sourceTitle: TILLCANN — Cannabis Mutant Phenotype + Sequencing Corpus
references.license: CC BY 4.0 article; data CC0 unless credited
references.diagnosticCeiling: Genetic cause should only be claimed with genotype/ploidy/mutation evidence or stable inherited pattern

references.sourceTitle: Cannabis Polyploidization Phenotype Reference
references.diagnosticCeiling: Use as a genetic hard negative, not as a common visual classifier target

references.sourceTitle: Cannadetect (Stages) — Cannabis Growth-Stage Detection
references.diagnosticCeiling: Stage label does not prove health; provenance/dedup QA required

references.sourceTitle: GBIF Licensed Occurrence Media Pool
references.diagnosticCeiling: Item-level determination can support organism ID but does not guarantee cannabis-host damage confirmation
